senses.gloss: Gṛtsamada, a ṛshi. § 730 (Ānuśāsanik.); XIII, 18, 1314 (ṛshiḥ Śakrasya dayitaḥ sakhā; cursed by Varishṭha, G. became a deer, then he sought the protection of Śiva).--§ 736b (Vītahavyop.): XIII, 30, 1997 (son of Vītahavya, the Daityas once took him for Indra), 1999, 2000 (father of Sucetas).
